entries.notes: Set only when IN_NIX_SHELL is non-empty (rust/run-cargo:10). Outside the Nix shell the script does not touch the name, so the caller's value passes to cargo unchanged. The CI test bin/ci/test-nix-rust-toolchain.sh:656-674 gives all nine names the value /bin/false and fails if 'cargo build', 'cargo fmt --check' or 'cargo doc' through rust/run-cargo does not succeed (outside this area).

setters.why: 'cargo fmt' must format with the rustfmt of the Nix toolchain

entries.values: A path to a rustfmt executable.

name: RUSTFMT
set_only_reader: third-party: cargo fmt. rust/run-cargo:27 sets it. No TRON reader.
